dedupe_keys.name: behavior of telecommunication lattice towers to thunderstorm winds eries bolt

description: ERIES-BOLT provides wind-engineering measurements for telecommunication lattice towers, produced by the Technical University of Civil Engineering of Bucharest and the Canadian WindEEE team. The Zenodo deposit organises wind-profile development, 1:100 models of 50 m and 90 m towers, and sectional-model experiments into separate packages. It includes measurement time histories, configurations and channel positions, with sample rates and timestamps stored in each MATLAB v6 data structure. An XLSX test programme and public DOCX guide explain the organisation and access. Coverage in the July 2024 release is a laboratory campaign, not a geographic inventory; the inspected landing metadata does not give a complete calendar span. Files are freely available under CC BY 4.0. A specimen-height inconsistency in the landing description should be resolved using the S2/S3 archive labels and internal test documentation before analysis. The data can calibrate wind-loading and structural-response models for telecom resilience, including models built with model-opensees. Scaling assumptions and differences between laboratory flows and real storms remain material limitations.
